ideas.name: any warning with the 5m ATR rising
ideas.why: 5m ATR up over 10% in the last half hour: volatility expanding, which is how trends start, so turns fail

ideas.name: 1m EMA warning with the MACD histogram still growing
ideas.why: the EMA gap easing while the 12/26/9 histogram still grows its side: the trend's momentum has not turned, so the EMA warning is early

ideas.name: any warning after 11:00 on a narrow day
ideas.why: past 11:00 CT with under half the usual day's range used: no one is moving the market, it rotates in a small box, and turns pay
